extracted.intended_audience: patent office staff, patent attorneys, and policymakers handling SPCs/PTEs in Germany
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and procedural standards for granting, numbering, publishing, and recording Supplementary Protection Certificates (SPCs) and Patent Term Extensions (PTEs) in Germany, including legal basis and database publication requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provision of SPCs/PTEs
rubrics_metrics.description: Does your Office/Organization provide SPCs or PTEs? Yes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Products eligible for SPC/PTE
rubrics_metrics.description: Please specify for which products an SPC or PTE can be obtained: medicinal products; plant protection products.

rubrics_metrics.name: Substantive requirements for granting SPCs or PTEs
rubrics_metrics.description: Examples: the product has been protected by a patent; the product has been subject to a regulatory review procedure before its commercial marketing or use; an SPC or PTE has never been granted on the product.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Substantive requirements for the grant of an SPC in the European Union are laid down in Article 3 and procedural requirements in Articles 7-9 of Regulation (EC) No 469/2009 (medicinal products) and (EC) No 1610/96 (plant protection products). DPMA Examination Guidelines (English) available: https://www.dpma.de/docs/english/formulare/patent_eng/p2799_1.pdf

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal basis for granting SPCs/PTEs
rubrics_metrics.description: European Union Regulations (EC) No 469/2009 (medicinal products) and (EC) No 1610/96 (plant protection products) are directly applicable in Germany via Sections 16a and 49a of the German Patent Act.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Unofficial translation of German Patent Act available at https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/englisch_patg/englisch_patg.html

rubrics_metrics.name: Name/term of the protection
rubrics_metrics.description: Name(s) of the SPCs or PTEs: DE - Supplementary Protection Certificate (German 'Ergänzendes Schutzzertifikat').

rubrics_metrics.name: Numbering system for SPC applications and grants
rubrics_metrics.description: Since 1 January 2004 in DE: Two digit identification number (12 for SPCs), followed by four digit year of application, followed by six digit annual serial number, followed by full stop and error checking number. Example: DE 12 2018 000 011.6
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Granted SPCs keep same number as indicated above for application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Which SPC/PTE events are published
rubrics_metrics.description: Events published include: Request (application) filed; SPC or PTE granted; SPC or PTE not granted; SPC or PTE opposed by third parties; SPC or PTE came into force; SPC or PTE ceased because of a lapse or expiry; Extension of SPC term requested; Extension of SPC term granted; Extension of SPC term not granted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The response indicates these events are published for medicinal products, plant protection products, and all products subject to regulatory approval for marketing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opposition and invalidity/revocation proceedings for SPCs
rubrics_metrics.description: There are no opposition proceedings for SPCs in Europe (cf. Art.19 (2) of Regulation (EC) No 469/2009). Invalidity actions against granted SPCs and revocation actions against extensions of SPC term are available (cf. Articles 15 and 16 of Regulation (EC) No 469/2009). Filing of a nullity/revocation action and the ultimate decision is published.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form(s) of publication for SPC/PTE events
rubrics_metrics.description: Events are published as part of an Official Gazette and through public online databases (DPMAregister: https://register.dpma.de/DPMAregister/pat/einsteiger).

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimum elements required in event publication
rubrics_metrics.description: Minimum elements that publication must contain: application number; filing date; name and address of the applicant; number of the relevant patent; title of the invention; name of the product; authorization details; date of the SPC or PTE authorization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timetable for publishing SPC/PTE information
rubrics_metrics.description: DPMAregister is updated overnight; publication in the Official Gazette ('Patentblatt' in Germany) can take up to 12 weeks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specimens/attachments of published events
rubrics_metrics.description: Specimens attached in response: DPMAregister__Patente_-_Registerauskunft_12_2007_000_033.pdf and PAT_1220050000418_2019-01-25.pdf.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples of the published announcements or register entries for reference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication of state changes for SPC/PTE (ST.27)
rubrics_metrics.description: Announcements of state changes published include changed to 'Active', changed to 'Not active', changed to 'Terminated'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Published for medicinal products, plant protection products, and all products subject to regulatory approval for marketing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form for publishing state-change announcements
rubrics_metrics.description: State-change announcements published through public online databases: DPMAregister (https://register.dpma.de/DPMAregister/pat/einsteiger).

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimum elements for state-change publication
rubrics_metrics.description: Minimum elements that publication must contain: registration number allotted to the SPC or PTE which has come into force; date of SPC or PTE registration which has come into force; name and address of the SPC or PTE holder; number of the relevant patent; title of the invention; name of the product; authorization details; date of SPC or PTE authorization; duration of the SPC or PTE.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: As ST.27 will be provided as additional information of the entry in the register, all information present in the register is available, i.e. classification, responsible department at the office, etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timetable for publishing state-change information
rubrics_metrics.description: Planned to go into production in 2019. Then: DPMAregister is updated overnight.
